Implemented: bd function uses Join-Path PSScriptRoot beads-query.ps1 for portable path resolution; builds positional array and namedParams hashtable then splats both with @positional @namedParams; LASTEXITCODE propagates transparently as the call is the last statement in the function.

Implemented: Invoke-List reads all issues via Get-Issues, applies optional --status filter (Where-Object), sorts by priority then id, applies --limit (Select-Object -First), outputs compact JSON array with --json or human-readable colour table with total count.

Implemented: bd-close accepts mandatory Id and optional -Reason (default Completed); calls bd close Id --reason Reason.

title: Scaffold core config files
description: Create package.json (name: ai-powered, v0.1.0, type: module, bin, main, types, exports map for '.' and 'ai-powered/web', scripts: build/build:web/dev:web/serve/test/lint/format/prepare, repository, keywords, files array). Create tsconfig.json (strict: true, module: NodeNext, outDir: dist, declaration: true, ESM target). Create vite.config.ts (lib mode, entry src/ai-powered/web/index.ts, dual ESM+UMD output to dist-web/). Create .env.example with all env vars commented: OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, XAI_API_KEY, VENICE_API_KEY, AI_PROVIDER, AI_MODEL, AI_PROFILE, AI_MOCK, NO_COLOR.

title: Scaffold project boilerplate and CI
description: Create .gitignore (node_modules/, dist/, dist-web/, .env, .env.local, .ai-powered/config.json, ai-powered.jsonl, ai-powered-audit.jsonl, logs/). Create .eslintrc.json and .prettierrc for TypeScript+ESM. Configure lint-staged in package.json. Create VERSION (0.1.0), LICENSE (MIT), empty CHANGELOG.md (v0.1.0 entry), CONTRIBUTING.md (branch naming, commit conventions, PR process, plugin authoring guide), SECURITY.md (key-handling, masking standards, vulnerability reporting, browser proxy-mode-only production requirement). Set up Husky: npm run prepare installs hooks; .husky/pre-commit runs lint-staged + secret-scanning script. Create .github/workflows/ci.yml: build, lint, test with AI_MOCK=true, npm publish on release event.

title: Define AiConfig Zod schema and layered config loader
description: In src/ai-powered/core.ts: Define AiConfig Zod schema (modality, provider, model, apiKey, temperature, maxTokens, systemPrompt, stream, profile, fallbackProviders, fallback bool, budgetSession, warnBudget, plugins, templateDirs, mock, logFile, debug, per-modality defaults). Implement layered config loader merging: global ~/.ai-powered/config.json -> project-local ./.ai-powered/config.json -> named profile -> env vars prefixed AI_ -> CLI flags. Each layer deep-merges. Validate merged config via Zod; throw ConfigError with all failures before any API call. Named profiles stored under 'profiles' key; throw ConfigError for missing profiles. Detect config version mismatch; backup old config to config.json.bak.<timestamp> and migrate. Spec: specs/config-system/spec.md.

title: Implement getAiClient factory and AiClient class
description: Export getAiClient(toolName?, overrides?) factory: reads layered config, resolves active profile, applies overrides (CLI flags highest precedence via deep-merge), instantiates provider via providers/index.ts, attaches plugin pipeline, returns configured AiClient. AiClient class methods: generateText(prompt, options?), generateImage(prompt, options?), transcribeAudio(buffer, options?), synthesizeSpeech(text, options?), generateVideo(prompt, options?), streamText(prompt, options?) -> AsyncIterable<string>, generateStructured<T>(prompt, schema, options?) -> Promise<T>, listModels(modality?), getCumulativeCost(), session(id). All accept optional AbortSignal. Unsupported modality -> ProviderCapabilityError. Export from src/ai-powered/index.ts as primary library entry point. Spec: specs/ai-core/spec.md.

title: Implement token estimation and cost calculator
description: Implement estimateTokens(text): number heuristic (labeled 'estimated' in all output). Cost calculator using provider-reported usage data; compute USD per call from model pricing lookup. Accumulate per-call cost in cumulativeCost. Every result object (TextResult, ImageResult, AudioResult) must include: usage.promptTokens, usage.completionTokens, usage.totalTokens, cost (USD float, 6 decimal places). getCumulativeCost() returns sum across session. Cost tracked in mock mode with plausible fixture values. Log cost at INFO level after each call. Result shapes: TextResult{content,model,usage,cost,modality:'text'}, ImageResult{data,model,cost,modality:'image'}. Spec: specs/resilience-and-cost/spec.md, specs/ai-core/spec.md.

title: Implement budget enforcement and model list cache
description: Budget: before every API call check cumulative cost against budgetSession ceiling; throw BudgetExceededError(currentCost, limit) with exit code 1 if limit would be exceeded. Emit WARNING log when cost crosses warnBudget threshold without blocking. BudgetExceededError must name current cost and configured limit. Model cache: listAvailableModels(provider, modality) using lru-cache, configurable TTL (default 5 min); second call within TTL returns cached result with no HTTP request. Result shape: { id, name, capabilities, contextWindow? }[]. Spec: specs/resilience-and-cost/spec.md, specs/ai-core/spec.md.

title: Implement BaseProvider abstract class and providers registry
description: Create src/ai-powered/providers/base.ts: BaseProvider abstract class with abstract methods for each modality (generateText, generateImage, transcribeAudio, synthesizeSpeech, generateVideo, streamText, listModels(modality)) and readonly name: string. Adding a provider = extend BaseProvider + register in index.ts only. Create providers/index.ts: map provider name -> class; export createProvider(config) factory. Spec: specs/providers/spec.md.

title: Implement OpenAI and Anthropic providers
description: OpenAiProvider using 'openai' npm SDK: GPT-4o and o1 series (text), DALL-E 3 (image), Whisper (transcription), TTS (synthesis). Read OPENAI_API_KEY; mask as 'sk-****' in all logs/output. Streaming via AsyncIterable<string> using OpenAI streaming API. AnthropicProvider using '@anthropic-ai/sdk': Claude models for text + streaming. Read ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; mask as 'sk-ant-****'. Unsupported modalities (image, audio, video) throw ProviderCapabilityError naming provider and modality. Spec: specs/providers/spec.md.

title: Implement xAI/Grok and Venice.ai providers
description: GrokProvider: text + streaming via latest official xAI SDK. Read XAI_API_KEY; mask as 'xai-****'. Unsupported modalities throw ProviderCapabilityError. NOTE: confirm xAI SDK npm package name before adding to package.json (design.md Open Question Q3). VeniceProvider: first-class named provider using 'openai' npm SDK with baseURL: 'https://api.venice.ai/api/v1' and VENICE_API_KEY (masked 'ven-****'). Text via /chat/completions (streaming, temperature, max_tokens, system prompt, structured JSON). Image via Venice image endpoint (confirm path: /image/generate vs /images/generations per design.md Q2). Audio/TTS/video gracefully throw ProviderCapabilityError. Dynamic model discovery via GET /models with capability filtering. Spec: specs/providers/spec.md.

title: Implement Custom/Ollama and Mock providers
description: CustomProvider: accept baseURL, apiKey, headers, type ('openai-compatible' | 'ollama' | 'other'). For Ollama (default http://localhost:11434): auto-detect models via GET /api/tags. Persist custom provider config in ~/.ai-powered/config.json. MockProvider in providers/mock.ts: deterministic fixture responses for ALL modalities without HTTP calls. Include plausible usage (token counts) and cost fields. When AI_MOCK=true: factory selects MockProvider regardless of configured real provider. Mock fixture shapes must match real provider API shapes exactly. Spec: specs/providers/spec.md, specs/ai-core/spec.md.

title: Implement exponential-backoff retry wrapper
description: In src/ai-powered/core.ts or resilience.ts: retry wrapper with default 3 retries, jitter, configurable max. Retry on: HTTP 429, 5xx server errors, network timeouts. Throw immediately (no retry) on 4xx except 429. Log each retry attempt at DEBUG: attempt number, wait duration, error reason. Spec: specs/resilience-and-cost/spec.md.

title: Implement per-provider circuit breaker
description: Per-provider circuit breaker: open after N consecutive failures (default 5). When open: fast-fail with CircuitOpenError including provider name and estimated recovery time. Reset after interval (default 60s): allow one probe request; on success close circuit. N and reset interval configurable via config. Spec: specs/resilience-and-cost/spec.md.

title: Implement provider fallback/failover loop
description: Config accepts ordered fallbackProviders array. On primary provider failure (network, rate limit, quota, open circuit): iterate fallbackProviders in order, log switchover at INFO level. Throw AllProvidersExhaustedError (listing all providers and failure reasons) if all fail. Disable via --no-fallback or fallback: false in config; throw immediately on primary failure when disabled. Return HTTP 503 from proxy server when all exhausted. Spec: specs/resilience-and-cost/spec.md.

title: Implement AiPlugin interface, plugin loader, and pipeline
description: Export from src/ai-powered/index.ts: AiPlugin interface { name: string; version: string; description?: string; onRequest?(ctx: RequestContext): Promise<RequestContext>; onResponse?(ctx: ResponseContext): Promise<ResponseContext>; onError?(err: AiPowerError): Promise<void> }. Export RequestContext and ResponseContext interfaces. Plugin loader: dynamically import() each plugin from config plugins array (file paths or npm package names). onRequest pipeline: registration order, executed before each provider call. onResponse pipeline: reverse order, after response. onError: broadcast to all plugins on AiPowerError. Plugins receive frozen copy of AiConfig (cannot mutate original). Spec: specs/plugin-system/spec.md.

title: Implement plugin sandboxing and PluginError handling
description: Plugin sandboxing: pass frozen Object.freeze() copy of AiConfig to each plugin hook. PluginError wrapping: if a plugin onRequest/onResponse throws, catch it, wrap as PluginError, log at WARNING, bypass that plugin for the remainder of the session, continue with remaining plugins. The overall request must NOT fail due to a single plugin's error. Spec: specs/plugin-system/spec.md.

title: Implement built-in plugins: audit-log, rate-limiter, prompt-shield
description: audit-log plugin: append JSONL entry per call to configurable path (default ./ai-powered-audit.jsonl). Entry: timestamp, provider, model, prompt hash (NOT raw prompt), usage, cost, masked headers. Mask all API keys via maskApiKey before writing. Activatable via plugins: ['audit-log']. rate-limiter plugin: client-side token-bucket, default 60 req/min configurable. When bucket empty, pause request (do NOT reject) until capacity available. prompt-shield plugin: heuristic injection-detection on every onRequest prompt. On detection: log WARNING with pattern. Configurable reject mode (default false); when reject: true, throw PluginError without dispatching to provider. Spec: specs/plugin-system/spec.md.

title: Implement template schema, renderTemplate, resolver, and listTemplates
description: Define template Zod schema (name, description, modality, provider?, model?, system?, userPrompt, defaults). Validate on load; throw ValidationError naming invalid file if userPrompt missing. renderTemplate(name, vars): mustache-style {{variable}} substitution; use defaults for missing vars. Template resolver search order: (1) built-in defaults/ dir, (2) config.templateDirs paths, (3) file path if contains path separator. User template overrides built-in by same name. listTemplates(): return all templates with name, modality, description (built-in and user-defined). Support --template <name> and --var <key>=<value> flags on text/image/audio speak/structured commands. Spec: specs/template-system/spec.md.

title: Create built-in templates: summarize, translate, qa
description: Create in src/ai-powered/templates/defaults/: summarize (text modality, summarizes input text {{text}}, includes language default so missing vars never error), translate (text modality, translates to {{targetLanguage}}, default: 'English'), qa (text modality, answers {{question}} from {{context}}). Each has meaningful description and sensible defaults. Bundle built-in template registry (no fs access) into web module for browser-safe use. Verify list-templates --json output includes all three. Spec: specs/template-system/spec.md.

title: Implement root Commander.js program and global flags
description: Register 'ai-powered' binary in package.json bin field. Root Commander.js program with lifecycle flags: --status, --init (create .ai-powered/, update .gitignore, run wizard if no config, print next steps), --update (check npm for newer version, update, migrate config), --uninstall (remove local hooks and repo-specific files), --install, --log, --debug. All commands support --help. Global flags on every command: --provider, --model, --api-key, --temperature, --max-tokens, --json, --modality, --stream, --profile, --mock, --dry-run, --quiet, --no-color, --no-fallback, --budget-session <USD>, --warn-budget <USD>, --log, --debug. Binary invokable after npm install -g; ai-powered --help exits code 0. Spec: specs/cli-commands/spec.md.

title: Implement modality commands: text, image, audio, video, structured
description: text: --stream, --session, --template, --var, --schema, all global flags. Read stdin when no prompt arg or --stdin flag. image: --output saves PNG/JPEG; without --output in --json mode print base64+MIME header, else warn. audio transcribe: read audio file or stdin. audio speak: --output saves MP3/WAV. video: --output. structured: --schema <file|json> (JSON Schema file, Zod schema file, or inline JSON string), --max-retries (default 2, retry when response fails schema validation). stdout = final results only; stderr = logs/errors/progress. Exit codes: 0 success, 1 error, 2 validation/health failure. NO_COLOR=1 env var disables ANSI. Spec: specs/cli-commands/spec.md, specs/structured-output/spec.md.

title: Implement wizard, list-models, list-templates, config, health-check
description: wizard/setup: delegate to cli/wizard.ts. list-models [modality]: query provider, --json returns JSON array. list-templates: all templates with name/modality/description, --json includes at minimum summarize/translate/qa. config sub-commands: get <key> (mask API keys in output), set <key> <value>, list (mask all keys), delete <key>, reset (prompt confirmation first), path, validate (full Zod schema, all errors, exit 0 if valid). title: [AI-003] Refactor cost estimation: accurate per-model/per-provider/per-modality pricing in server and web demo
description:
## Problem

The current cost tracking is inaccurate or silent for most providers and modalities:

### Web demo (integrations/web-example/app.js)
- ddUsage() ignores the cost field already returned by the server and recalculates using a hardcoded COST_PER_TOKEN table with flat per-provider rates (e.g. openai=5e-6, anthropic=7.5e-6). This is always wrong for image, audio, and video modalities.
- When totalTokens is 0 (image/video/audio calls), ddUsage() adds nothing to the session cost — so video and image calls show \.000000 even when there IS a real cost.
- The setUsageText() helper only shows token counts, not the actual call cost.
- COST_PER_TOKEN does not include lumaai at all.

### Server utils.ts (src/ai-powered/utils.ts)
- ModelPricing interface has no field for video pricing (no perVideoUsd, no durationSeconds-based video cost).
- MODEL_PRICING table has no entries for Luma AI models (ray-2, ray-flash-2, ray-2-720p, etc.).
- mock-video-v1 is priced as perImage which is incorrect for a video model.
- Venice and xAI entries may have stale rates.
- calculateCost() has no video branch — video calls fall through to token-based math producing \.000000.
- estimateCost() similarly produces \.000000 for video prompts.

### Server routes.ts (src/ai-powered/server/routes.ts)
- The /video and /video/from-image routes must ensure the cost field in the JSON response uses the actual calculated cost (not zeroed). Confirm cost is included in the response body for all modalities.

## Required Changes

### 1. utils.ts — Extend ModelPricing + pricing table
- Add perVideoUsd?: number field to ModelPricing interface (fixed per-video-clip cost).
- Add Luma AI model entries: ray-2 (\.14), ray-flash-2 (\.04), ray-2-720p (\.14), ray-flash-2-720p (\.04), dream-machine (\.14). Source: https://lumalabs.ai/dream-machine/api/pricing
- Fix mock-video-v1: use perVideoUsd instead of perImage.
- Audit and update xAI (grok-2, grok-beta) and Venice rates against 2026 public pricing.
- Add calculateCost() video branch: if pricing.perVideoUsd is set, raw = perVideoUsd.
- Add estimateCost() video branch: same fixed cost logic.

### 2. providers/lumaai.ts — Populate cost in VideoResult
- After generateVideo() and generateVideoFromImage() succeed, call calculateCost(model, usage) and include the result in the returned VideoResult.cost field.
- Confirm usage field has zeroed TokenUsage (already correct) so calculateCost falls through to perVideoUsd.

### 3. server/routes.ts — Verify cost passthrough
- Confirm /video and /video/from-image responses include cost: { totalUsd, isEstimate } in the JSON body.
- Confirm /text, /image, /audio/*, /structured all already pass cost through (audit each route).

### 4. app.js — Use server cost; fix addUsage()
- Remove hardcoded COST_PER_TOKEN table and the per-token recalculation entirely.
- Update addUsage(usage, cost) to accept an optional CostBreakdown cost parameter.
- If cost.totalUsd is provided (from the server response), add it to 	otalCost directly.
- Tokens: continue accumulating totalTokens from usage.totalTokens (may be 0 for video/image — that is correct).
- Display: session cost should always update even when tokens = 0.
- Update setUsageText() to also show the call cost: e.g. 'Tokens: 42 · Cost: \.000040'.
- Pass result.cost from each handler (handleTextGenerate, handleImageGenerate, handleVideoGenerate, etc.) into addUsage().

### 5. app.js — Luma AI provider label fix
- proxyProviderSelect currently shows active providers without a star and inactive with ★. The label logic is inverted for lumaai (shows ★ when key IS set). Fix opt.textContent and opt.title so ★ means 'API key configured'.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Text call: session cost increments by the correct model-specific token-based cost (e.g. gpt-4o: \.000005 per token).
- [ ] Image call: session cost increments by perImageUsd (e.g. dall-e-3: \.04).
- [ ] Video call (Luma AI): session cost increments by perVideoUsd (e.g. ray-2: \.14). Tokens remain 0 — that is correct.
- [ ] Audio call: session cost increments by duration-based cost.
- [ ] Session cost never stays at \.000000 after a successful non-text call.
- [ ] tsc --noEmit passes with zero errors after all changes.
- [ ] All existing tests continue to pass (no regressions in providers.test.ts or utils unit tests).

## Ref
- src/ai-powered/utils.ts — ModelPricing, MODEL_PRICING, calculateCost, estimateCost
- src/ai-powered/providers/lumaai.ts — VideoResult population
- src/ai-powered/server/routes.ts — cost passthrough
- integrations/web-example/app.js — addUsage(), COST_PER_TOKEN, setUsageText()
- design.md D5 (budget enforcement), tasks.md

title: [app-007] Surface proxy-unreachable errors in loadModels and loadProviders
description: STORY | File: integrations/web-example/app.js | Priority: Medium | Effort: S (~2h) | Both loadModels and loadProviders silently swallow every error with catch (_) { /* server not running */ }. When the proxy is offline or misconfigured, dropdowns stay at 'Default' with no user feedback — especially harmful in the Video tab where 'Default' means unpredictable provider selection and unexpected costs. Two failure modes must be distinguished: (1) TypeError from fetch (network unreachable / connection refused) and (2) SyntaxError from .json() (server returned non-JSON e.g. a 502 HTML page). Fix: hoist base before try in both functions; add typed catch handlers calling showGlobalError; add clearGlobalError() on loadProviders success. Spec: openspec/changes/app-007/ | Source: ai-prompts/App-007.md

title: [app-008] Add circuit-breaker and exponential-backoff retry to WebAiClient
description: STORY | Files: src/ai-powered/shared/resilience.ts (new), src/ai-powered/web/fetch-client.ts, src/ai-powered/resilience.ts | Priority: High | Effort: M (~6h) | WebAiClient makes raw fetch() calls with no retry or circuit protection. A transient 429/503 immediately surfaces as an unrecoverable error. The Node AiClient already has withRetry + CircuitBreaker; this story closes the gap for browser consumers by (1) extracting browser-safe resilience primitives into a shared/ module, (2) wiring withRetryFetch + CircuitBreaker into every WebAiClient fetch call, and (3) re-exporting the shared primitives from the Node resilience module. No breaking changes. Spec: openspec/changes/app-008/ | Source: ai-prompts/App-008.md | Design: openspec/changes/app-008/design.md

title: [app-008] T-001: Create src/ai-powered/shared/ directory

title: [app-008] T-002: Create src/ai-powered/shared/resilience.ts
description: PHASE-1 CODE | File: src/ai-powered/shared/resilience.ts (new) | Implement the full browser-safe resilience module. Required exports: (1) RetryOptions interface (maxRetries, backoffBase, backoffCap, retryOn fields — all optional). (2) jitterDelay(attempt, base?, cap?) — Full Jitter formula: Math.random() * Math.min(cap, base * 2^attempt). (3) sleep(ms) — setTimeout-based Promise. (4) withRetryFetch(fn, opts?, signal?) — retries on 429|503 up to maxRetries times; wires AbortSignal into inter-retry delay so abort cancels immediately. (5) CircuitState type: 'CLOSED'|'OPEN'|'HALF_OPEN'. (6) CircuitBreaker class with state getter and call<T>(fn) method implementing three-state machine. CRITICAL: zero node: imports — use only setTimeout, Promise, standard DOM types. Full implementation in: openspec/changes/app-008/deltas.md (Delta 1) | Spec: specs/shared-resilience/spec.md

title: [copy-save] T-004: Implement createSearchBar(container) internal helper
description: PHASE-1 CODE | File: integrations/web-example/app.js | Internal helper called by createReplyToolbar for text modality. Build the .reply-search-bar DOM: an input.reply-search-input, a span.reply-search-counter (aria-live='polite', aria-atomic='true'), and a close button (✕). Wire events: (a) 500ms debounce on 'input' event calling applySearchHighlights. (b) 'keydown' Escape to hide bar + clearSearchHighlights. (c) Close ✕ button click to hide bar + clearSearchHighlights. Spec: specs/inline-search/spec.md (R-001, R-005, R-006, R-007, R-008) | Design: design.md (500ms Debounce)

title: [copy-save] T-005: Implement copyReplyContent(descriptor, btn) async
description: PHASE-1 CODE | File: integrations/web-example/app.js | Async copy action handler. Paths: (a) Text/audio-with-transcript: if window.isSecureContext && navigator.clipboard, call await navigator.clipboard.writeText(descriptor.text ?? ''). Else: create hidden <textarea>, set value, document.execCommand('copy'), remove textarea. (b) Image: obtain blob via dataUrlToBlob(descriptor.dataUrl) or fetch(descriptor.srcUrl).blob(), then await navigator.clipboard.write([new ClipboardItem({[blob.type]: blob})]). (c) Null data guard: if all sources null, showToolbarFeedback(btn, '⚠ No data') and return. (d) On success: showToolbarFeedback(btn, '✓ Copied'). (e) On error: showToolbarFeedback(btn, '⚠ Failed') + console.error('[reply-toolbar] copy failed:', err). Spec: specs/copy-action/spec.md (R-001 through R-006) | Design: design.md (Clipboard API vs execCommand)

title: [copy-save] T-006: Implement saveReplyContent(descriptor, btn) async
description: PHASE-1 CODE | File: integrations/web-example/app.js | Async save action handler. Steps: (a) Disable btn + set textContent='…' immediately. (b) Blob acquisition: dataUrlToBlob(descriptor.dataUrl) if non-null; else fetch(descriptor.srcUrl) => resp.blob() (throw if !resp.ok). (c) If both null: showToolbarFeedback(btn, '⚠ No data') + return. (d) Filename: descriptor.filename ?? 'ai-reply.' + mimeToExt(mimeType). (e) Mobile share path: if supportsShare([file]) => await navigator.share({files:[file], title:filename}); catch AbortError silently. (f) Desktop path: triggerDownload(blob, filename). (g) showToolbarFeedback(btn, '✓ Saved') on success. (h) On error: console.error('[reply-toolbar] save failed:', err) + showToolbarFeedback(btn, '⚠ Failed'). Spec: specs/save-action/spec.md (R-001 through R-010) | Design: design.md (Web Share API vs a download, Fetch Strategy for Remote Video)

title: [copy-save] T-007: Implement activateInlineSearch(container, searchBtn)
description: PHASE-1 CODE | File: integrations/web-example/app.js | Toggle function for the inline search bar. Behavior: (a) Find .reply-search-bar within container. (b) If bar has .hidden class (currently closed): remove .hidden; focus the search input element. (c) If bar is visible (currently open): add .hidden; call clearSearchHighlights(container); reset counter.textContent to ''; call searchBtn.focus() to return focus to the toolbar. Spec: specs/inline-search/spec.md (R-002) | Scenarios: 'Search bar toggled open' and 'Clear highlights on close'

title: [copy-save] T-008: Implement applySearchHighlights(container, input, counter)
description: PHASE-1 CODE | File: integrations/web-example/app.js | Real-time regex highlight engine (called by debounce in T-004). Steps: (a) Call clearSearchHighlights(container) to remove stale marks. (b) Remove .reply-search-input--invalid from input; if input.value.trim() is empty, set counter.textContent='' and return. (c) Construct new RegExp(query, 'gi') in try/catch. On SyntaxError: add .reply-search-input--invalid, set counter.textContent='⚠ invalid regex', return. (d) Walk text nodes via document.createTreeWalker(container, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT). Skip nodes whose closest ancestor is .reply-toolbar or .reply-search-bar. (e) For each matching node, build a DocumentFragment: non-match text as Text nodes, match text wrapped in <mark class='reply-search-highlight'>. Replace original node with fragment. (f) Set counter.textContent to 'N match(es)' or 'no matches'. Spec: specs/inline-search/spec.md (R-003) | Design: design.md (TreeWalker for Search)

title: [copy-save] T-009: Implement clearSearchHighlights(container)
description: PHASE-1 CODE | File: integrations/web-example/app.js | Cleanup function to remove all highlight marks. Steps: (a) Query container.querySelectorAll('mark.reply-search-highlight'). (b) For each mark: insert a new Text(mark.textContent) before the mark in the parent, then remove the mark element. (c) Collect the set of parent elements and call parent.normalize() on each to merge adjacent text nodes, preventing fragmentation from accumulating across repeated search operations. Spec: specs/inline-search/spec.md (R-004) | AC-5: zero marks remain, text content unchanged

title: [copy-save] T-010: Implement showToolbarFeedback(btn, message, durationMs=1800)
description: PHASE-1 CODE | File: integrations/web-example/app.js | Transient feedback helper used by all async actions. Steps: (a) Capture btn.textContent (original label). (b) Set btn.textContent=message, btn.classList.add('reply-toolbar-btn--feedback'), btn.disabled=true. (c) After durationMs ms: restore btn.textContent to original label, btn.classList.remove('reply-toolbar-btn--feedback'), btn.disabled=false. MUST NOT throw if btn is already disabled at call time. Default durationMs=1800ms (design.md Default Parameters table). Spec: specs/reply-toolbar-core/spec.md (R-004) | Tests: tests/copy-save.test.js (showToolbarFeedback describe block)

title: [copy-save] T-011: Implement triggerDownload(blob, filename)
description: PHASE-1 CODE | File: integrations/web-example/app.js | Programmatic download helper. Steps: (a) const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob). (b) Create <a> element: href=url, download=filename, style.display='none'. (c) document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); document.body.removeChild(a). (d) Schedule URL.revokeObjectURL(url) via setTimeout at 60,000ms to allow Chrome's download bar animation to complete before the object URL is invalidated. Spec: specs/save-action/spec.md (R-006, AC-8) | Design: design.md (Default Parameters — triggerDownload revoke delay 60,000ms)

title: [copy-save] T-012: Implement dataUrlToBlob(dataUrl)
description: PHASE-1 CODE | File: integrations/web-example/app.js | Convert a base-64 data URL to a Blob without using fetch() (fetch(dataUrl) is restricted on some browsers). Algorithm: (1) Split on ',' to get header and payload. (2) Extract mimeType from header via header.split(':')[1].split(';')[0]. (3) Decode payload via atob(). (4) Build Uint8Array from char codes. (5) Return new Blob([uint8Array], { type: mimeType }). Used by both copyReplyContent (image path) and saveReplyContent (dataUrl path). Spec: specs/copy-action/spec.md (R-006) | Tests: tests/copy-save.test.js (dataUrlToBlob describe block)

title: [copy-save] T-013: Implement mimeToExt(mimeType)
description: PHASE-1 CODE | File: integrations/web-example/app.js | MIME type to file extension mapper. Required mappings: image/png->png, image/jpeg->jpg, image/webp->webp, image/gif->gif, audio/mpeg->mp3, audio/ogg->ogg, audio/wav->wav, video/mp4->mp4, video/webm->webm, text/plain->txt. Must return 'bin' for any unmapped type. Implement as a const map object with a fallback. Used by saveReplyContent (R-003 filename resolution). Spec: specs/save-action/spec.md (R-007, AC-7) | Tests: tests/copy-save.test.js (mimeToExt describe block — 10 known types + 3 unknown fallbacks)

title: [copy-save] T-014: Implement isMobile()
description: PHASE-1 CODE | File: integrations/web-example/app.js | UA-string heuristic for mobile detection. Implementation: return /Android|iPhone|iPad|iPod|Mobile/i.test(navigator.userAgent). Used by saveReplyContent to choose between Web Share API (mobile) and <a download> (desktop). Note: supportsShare() adds a second check via navigator.canShare, so isMobile() alone is not the sole gating condition. Spec: specs/save-action/spec.md (R-008) | Tests: tests/copy-save.test.js (isMobile describe — 4 UA fixtures)

title: [copy-save] T-015: Implement supportsShare(files)
description: PHASE-1 CODE | File: integrations/web-example/app.js | Web Share API capability detection. Steps: (a) If typeof navigator.share !== 'function': return false. (b) If files array is provided AND navigator.canShare is available: return navigator.canShare({ files }). (c) Otherwise: return true (share is present and canShare unavailable, so optimistically allow). Used by saveReplyContent (R-004) to decide mobile share vs desktop download path. Design: design.md (Web Share API vs a download, Detection section). title: [app-010] Add client-side budget enforcement to direct-mode WebAiClient
description: STORY | Files: src/ai-powered/web/fetch-client.ts (modified), integrations/web-example/index.html (modified), integrations/web-example/app.js (modified) | Priority: High | Effort: S (~3h) | WebAiClient in direct mode bypasses the Node proxy and its BudgetExceededError guard. A user running a large batch has no per-session spending cap. This story closes the gap by (1) adding WebBudgetOptions interface to WebClientOptions, (2) wiring _checkBudget()/_accumulateCost() into applicable methods, and (3) wiring a budget input in the web example UI. No breaking changes. budgetUsd defaults to Infinity. Depends on App-008 (WebResilienceOptions pattern). Spec: openspec/changes/app-010/ | Source: ai-prompts/App-010.md

title: [app-010] T-001: Add BudgetExceededError import to fetch-client.ts
description: PHASE-1 CODE | File: src/ai-powered/web/fetch-client.ts | Add import at top of file: import { BudgetExceededError } from '../types.js'; BudgetExceededError is already exported from src/ai-powered/types.ts with public fields spentUsd: number and budgetUsd: number. No changes to types.ts are needed. The .js extension is required for ESM resolution even though the source file is .ts. Spec: openspec/changes/app-010/deltas.md (Delta 1, Step 1a) | specs/web-budget-options/spec.md (R-003)

title: [app-010] T-002: Export WebBudgetOptions interface from fetch-client.ts
description: PHASE-1 CODE | File: src/ai-powered/web/fetch-client.ts | After the existing WebResilienceOptions interface, insert: export interface WebBudgetOptions { budgetUsd?: number; warnFraction?: number; } budgetUsd: maximum cumulative spend in USD for this client instance. Default: Infinity (no cap). When _spentUsd + estimatedUsd >= budgetUsd, BudgetExceededError is thrown before any fetch is issued. warnFraction: fraction of budgetUsd at which console.warn is emitted. Default: 0.8. Follows the same pattern as WebResilienceOptions from App-008. Spec: openspec/changes/app-010/deltas.md (Delta 1, Step 1b) | specs/web-budget-options/spec.md (R-001, R-002)

title: [app-010] T-003: Update WebClientOptions to intersect with WebBudgetOptions
description: PHASE-1 CODE | File: src/ai-powered/web/fetch-client.ts | Change: export type WebClientOptions = (WebProxyOptions | WebDirectOptions) & WebResilienceOptions; To: export type WebClientOptions = (WebProxyOptions | WebDirectOptions) & WebResilienceOptions & WebBudgetOptions; The & intersection (not |) ensures budget options are available regardless of proxy or direct mode. All new fields are optional so existing call sites are unaffected — new WebAiClient({ mode: 'direct', apiKey: '...' }) continues to compile and run with budgetUsd defaulting to Infinity. Spec: openspec/changes/app-010/deltas.md (Delta 1, Step 1b) | specs/web-budget-options/spec.md (R-004)

title: [app-010] T-004: Add private budget fields to WebAiClient class
description: PHASE-1 CODE | File: src/ai-powered/web/fetch-client.ts | Inside the WebAiClient class body, after the existing _breaker field, add three private fields: private _spentUsd = 0; private readonly _budgetUsd: number; private readonly _warnFraction: number; _spentUsd is mutable (incremented by _accumulateCost). _budgetUsd and _warnFraction are readonly because they are set once in the constructor from opts and never change. Design rationale: openspec/changes/app-010/design.md (Default Parameters table) | Spec: specs/web-budget-guard/spec.md (R-001)

description: PHASE-1 CODE | File: src/ai-powered/web/fetch-client.ts | In the WebAiClient constructor body, after this._breaker = new CircuitBreaker(), add: this._budgetUsd = opts.budgetUsd ?? Infinity; this._warnFraction = opts.warnFraction ?? 0.8; Default of Infinity means budget enforcement is a strict no-op when budgetUsd is not supplied — _checkBudget() will never throw and _accumulateCost() will never emit a warning (guarded by this._budgetUsd < Infinity check). Spec: openspec/changes/app-010/deltas.md (Delta 1, Step 1d) | specs/web-budget-options/spec.md (R-002, AC-3)

title: [app-010] T-006: Add spentUsd read-only getter to WebAiClient
description: PHASE-2 CODE | File: src/ai-powered/web/fetch-client.ts | After the constructor, add a public read-only getter: get spentUsd(): number { return this._spentUsd; } This exposes the running spend total for use in UI display and test assertions without revealing the mutable _spentUsd backing field directly. Example test usage: expect(client.spentUsd).toBeCloseTo(0.0024). Example UI usage: budgetDisplay.textContent = client.spentUsd.toFixed(4). Spec: openspec/changes/app-010/deltas.md (Delta 1, Step 1e) | specs/web-budget-guard/spec.md (R-004)

title: [app-010] T-007: Implement private _checkBudget() method
description: PHASE-2 CODE | File: src/ai-powered/web/fetch-client.ts | Implement the pre-call guard: private _checkBudget(estimatedUsd = 0): void { if (this._spentUsd + estimatedUsd >= this._budgetUsd) { throw new BudgetExceededError(this._spentUsd + estimatedUsd, this._budgetUsd); } } CRITICAL: uses >= (not >) so the boundary condition (spentUsd exactly equals budgetUsd) correctly blocks the next call. estimatedUsd defaults to 0 — no token pre-estimation in the browser (no tokenizer dependency). The guard fires BEFORE any fetch is issued. BudgetExceededError constructor takes (spentUsd, budgetUsd) — both are public fields on the thrown error. Spec: openspec/changes/app-010/deltas.md (Delta 1, Step 1e) | specs/web-budget-guard/spec.md (R-002, AC-1, AC-2)

title: [app-010] T-008: Implement private _accumulateCost() method
description: PHASE-2 CODE | File: src/ai-powered/web/fetch-client.ts | Implement the post-call accumulator: private _accumulateCost(result: { cost?: { totalUsd: number } }): void { const cost = result?.cost?.totalUsd ?? 0; this._spentUsd += cost; if (this._budgetUsd < Infinity && this._spentUsd / this._budgetUsd >= this._warnFraction) { console.warn('[WebAiClient] Budget warning: $' + this._spentUsd.toFixed(4) + ' of $' + this._budgetUsd.toFixed(2) + ' used (' + (this._spentUsd / this._budgetUsd * 100).toFixed(1) + '%)'); } } The this._budgetUsd < Infinity guard short-circuits the warning entirely when no budget is set — zero overhead for the common no-budget case. Uses console.warn (not getLogger) since the browser has no pino logger. Spec: openspec/changes/app-010/deltas.md (Delta 1, Step 1e) | specs/web-budget-guard/spec.md (R-003, AC-3, AC-4)

The accumulate call must come after JSON.parse/schema validation so result.cost is available. Spec: openspec/changes/app-010/deltas.md (Delta 1, Step 1f) | specs/web-budget-guard/spec.md (R-002, R-003, AC-2)

title: [app-011] Replace generic proxy errors with typed ProxyError and severity-aware banners
description: STORY | Files: integrations/web-example/app.js (modified), integrations/web-example/index.html (modified) | Priority: High | Effort: S (~2h) | proxyPost and proxyStream throw plain Error('Server error N') — the HTTP status is a string prefix, not a structured property. All three distinct proxy error codes (402 budget, 429 rate-limit, 503 all-providers-down) render as an identical red banner. This story adds ProxyError extends Error with statusCode property, extends showGlobalError with optional severity param, and updates all 8 proxy-calling catch blocks with status-code-aware banner copy and colour. No new npm packages. No TypeScript changes. Spec: openspec/changes/app-011/ | Source: ai-prompts/App-011.md

title: [app-011] T-001: Add ProxyError class to app.js before proxyPost
description: PHASE-1 CODE | File: integrations/web-example/app.js | Insert before proxyPost (~line 775): class ProxyError extends Error { constructor(statusCode, message) { super(message); this.name = 'ProxyError'; this.statusCode = statusCode; } } Properties: name (always 'ProxyError'), statusCode (number, HTTP status), message (string, from JSON body). Design: plain JS class — no npm dependency (design.md: Plain JS Class decision). Naming: ProxyError not HttpError because it is scoped to errors from the ai-powered proxy server specifically. instanceof Error === true, instanceof ProxyError === true. Spec: openspec/changes/app-011/deltas.md (Delta 1a) | specs/proxy-error-class/spec.md

title: [app-011] T-002: Update proxyPost !resp.ok block to throw ProxyError
description: PHASE-1 CODE | File: integrations/web-example/app.js | Find the if (!resp.ok) block inside proxyPost (~line 798). BEFORE: const httpErr = new Error('Server error ' + resp.status + ': ' + msg); showGlobalError(httpErr.message); throw httpErr; AFTER: throw new ProxyError(resp.status, msg); where msg = j.error ?? j.message ?? 'Server error {status}'. CRITICAL CHANGE: Remove the inline showGlobalError() call from proxyPost entirely — banner display is now the catch block's responsibility, enabling per-status-code severity control. Message extraction priority: j.error (primary), j.message (secondary fallback), template fallback. Spec: openspec/changes/app-011/deltas.md (Delta 1c) | specs/proxy-error-class/spec.md (AC-5, AC-7, AC-8)

title: [app-011] T-003: Update proxyStream !resp.ok block to throw ProxyError
description: PHASE-1 CODE | File: integrations/web-example/app.js | Find the if (!resp.ok) block inside proxyStream (~line 823). BEFORE: throw new Error(msg); where msg = j.error ?? msg (no j.message fallback). AFTER: throw new ProxyError(resp.status, msg); where msg = j.error ?? j.message ?? 'Server error {status}'. Two changes: (1) Error -> ProxyError with resp.status as first arg. (2) Add j.message as secondary fallback before the template string fallback, matching the proxyPost pattern. Note: proxyStream network errors (fetch() throws) remain as plain Error('Network error: ...') and will correctly fall through to the else branch of updated catch blocks. Spec: openspec/changes/app-011/deltas.md (Delta 1d) | specs/proxy-error-class/spec.md (AC-6)

title: [app-011] T-004: Update showGlobalError signature to accept severity param
description: PHASE-2 CODE | File: integrations/web-example/app.js | Find function showGlobalError(msg) (~line 462). Change signature to: function showGlobalError(message, severity = 'error') Default severity is 'error' — this is the key backward-compatibility guarantee. All existing single-arg call sites (loadProviders, loadModels, window.onerror, unhandledrejection, video proxy-mode guard) continue to render the red banner unchanged with zero code changes. Design: default='error' chosen explicitly over 'info' or 'warning' because unknown/unexpected errors should always be red (design.md: Severity Default decision). Spec: openspec/changes/app-011/deltas.md (Delta 1b) | specs/severity-aware-banner/spec.md (AC-1, AC-2)

title: [app-011] T-005: Update showGlobalError DOM manipulation to apply severity class
description: PHASE-2 CODE | File: integrations/web-example/app.js | In showGlobalError body, make two changes: (1) rename msg parameter usage to message (globalErrorMsg.textContent = message).
